member.name: T:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.ApiControllerBase
member.summary: Base class for every controller. Gives access to the logged-in user's id and role (read from the server-side session) and a helper for consistent errors.

member.name: T:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.AuthController
member.summary: Registration, login and logout. Login creates a server-side session.

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.AuthController.Register(RaceDay.Api.Dtos.RegisterRequest)
member.summary: Registers a new account as either an Organiser or a Participant.
member.remarks: Public endpoint. The password is hashed (PBKDF2 + random salt) before it is stored and is never returned. Email addresses must be unique.
member.param: FullName, Email, Password (min 8 chars), Role ("Organiser" or "Participant") and optional ContactNumber.
member.response: Account created. Returns the new user profile (no password).
A field is missing or invalid (for example an unknown role).
That email address is already registered.

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.AuthController.Login(RaceDay.Api.Dtos.LoginRequest)
member.summary: Logs in and starts a session that remembers the user's id and role.
member.remarks: Public endpoint. On success a session cookie is issued; every later request made with that cookie is treated as logged in, with the stored role (Organiser or Participant).
member.response: Login successful. Returns the user id, name and role.

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.AuthController.Logout
member.summary: Logs out and destroys the current session.
member.remarks: Requires login (any role).

member.name: T:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.CategoriesController
member.summary: Managing categories and enrolling Participants into them.

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.CategoriesController.UpdateCategory(System.Int32,RaceDay.Api.Dtos.CategoryRequest)
member.summary: Updates a category.
member.remarks: Organisers only, and only for categories that belong to their own events.
member.response: A field is missing or invalid.
Not an Organiser, or the category belongs to a different Organiser's event.

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.CategoriesController.DeleteCategory(System.Int32)
member.summary: Deletes a category.
member.remarks: Organisers only, for their own events. A category that already has enrolments cannot be deleted.
member.response: Not an Organiser, or the category belongs to a different Organiser's event.
The category has enrolments and cannot be deleted.

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.CategoriesController.Enrol(System.Int32)
member.summary: Enrols the logged-in Participant into a category and issues a bib number.
member.remarks: Participants only. The enrolment records the link between the Participant, the category and (through the category) the event. The event must be "Open", the category must not be full, and a Participant cannot enrol in the same category twice.
member.response: The enrolment, including the bib number.
The event is not open for enrolment, or the category is full.
The logged-in user is not a Participant.
The Participant is already enrolled in this category.

member.name: T:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.EnrolmentsController
member.summary: Cancelling enrolments, and viewing the results and payments of an enrolment. Requires login.

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.EnrolmentsController.CancelEnrolment(System.Int32)
member.summary: Cancels an enrolment.
member.remarks: The Participant who owns the enrolment, or the Organiser of the event, may cancel it. The record is kept with status "Cancelled" so results and payments stay traceable.
member.response: The enrolment belongs to someone else's registration and a different Organiser's event.

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.EnrolmentsController.GetResult(System.Int32)
member.summary: Returns the result for one enrolment.
member.remarks: The Participant who owns the enrolment, or the Organiser of the event, may view it.
member.response: The enrolment is not yours and the event is not yours.
No such enrolment, or no result has been recorded yet.

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.EnrolmentsController.AddPayment(System.Int32,RaceDay.Api.Dtos.PaymentRequest)
member.summary: Records a payment for an enrolment.
member.remarks: Participants only, for their own enrolments. The amount must equal the category's entry fee. A successful payment confirms the enrolment. (No real payment gateway is called; this is a simulation.)
member.param: Amount and PaymentMethod (Card, EFT or Cash).
member.response: Invalid fields, or the amount does not match the entry fee.
Not a Participant, or the enrolment belongs to someone else.
The enrolment is cancelled or has already been paid.

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.EnrolmentsController.GetPayments(System.Int32)
member.summary: Returns the payment history of an enrolment.
member.remarks: The Participant who owns the enrolment, or the Organiser of the event, may view it.
member.response: The enrolment is not yours and the event is not yours.
